authentication_notes: /session is the primary authentication entry point. All authenticated operations depend on a valid session token obtained from /session. Some endpoints have additional role-based restrictions (admin, officer, citizen, external maintainer) enforced at runtime.
Temporary user creation and OTP verification do not require prior authentication but result in a permanent user that can authenticate via /session.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.

risks: /users/temporary and /otp/resend do not specify authentication requirements but may be vulnerable to abuse if rate-limited improperly.
/reports/approved is public; ensure it does not leak sensitive internal data.
Role-based restrictions (admin, officer, citizen, external maintainer) are documented in descriptions but not enforced by auth_required flags; runtime checks are assumed.
DELETE /employees/{id} and DELETE /employees/tecnhnical-officers/remove lack path parameter schema in the provided snippet; ensure implementation matches documentation.
/bot/verify/password accepts plaintext password in request body without authentication; consider secure transmission and rate limiting.
